explication: LibreNMS is an auto-discovering network-monitoring system: it gathers device information and presents monitoring results, with alerting, authentication, and storage management as important supporting capabilities. The tree and excerpts show the storage collection path in detail, while most other runtime subsystems are represented by their source paths only. Accordingly, unsampled connections are shown as unverified rather than asserted as source-confirmed calls.
